intro.title: Everything QuietJar does.
intro.sub: A donation button that lives on your site: static, fast, and polite. It loads in 40 ms, pays with the methods people already use, and steps back once someone has given.

widget.title: A static widget that loads in 40 ms.
widget.description: The button is one small script that loads without holding up your page. Your page stays exactly as fast as it was.
bullets: Floats in a fixed corner layer, so it displaces nothing on your page
No tracking, no cookie banner, nothing to consent to

setup.title: Live on your site in three steps.
setup.description: Sign up, connect a bank account, and paste a short snippet. It takes a few minutes, and there is nothing to install or maintain.
bullets: Works on any site that lets you paste HTML
Every setting has a default, so the snippet works as pasted
Style the button in your dashboard before you copy it

steps.title: Sign up
steps.description: Enter your email and we send you a one-time code. No password.

steps.title: Connect your bank
steps.description: Add your site and the account your payouts go to.

steps.title: Paste the snippet
steps.description: Just before the closing body tag.

payments.title: Pay the way people already pay.
payments.description: Apple Pay, Google Pay, cards, and local methods like iDEAL, Bancontact, and Revolut Pay, directly on your site. Two taps on desktop, the same on mobile. Nobody gets sent anywhere.

mock.alt: The QuietJar checkout on a docs site, offering iDEAL, card, Bancontact, Revolut Pay, and Pay By Bank for a €5 donation
mock.caption: Apple Pay and Google Pay appear on devices that support them.

goals.title: Add a goal for +50% more conversions.
goals.description: Give the button a public target and a bar that fills toward it: hosting for the year, the next release, a new microphone. Concrete goals lift the amounts people choose.
bullets: Pick a target and the widget turns into a card with a progress meter
Choose what happens when the goal is reached: hide the widget, keep the button, or keep the bar
The meter updates as donations come in

mock.headline: Enjoying the docs?
mock.body: Funds more posts like this one.

image.title: Works where scripts can't.
image.description: A dynamic image that links straight into your donation panel. Drop it in your GitHub README or a newsletter, and it auto-updates with your goal progress.
bullets: An img tag for READMEs, newsletters, anywhere a script can't run
Renders your real widget, so it auto-updates with your goal
Clicks straight into your donation panel

configurable.title: Tuned to your site, down to the CSS.
configurable.description: Position, color, font, icon, headline and body, when to show and hide, how long to stay hidden. And custom CSS if you want full control.

cta.title: Ready in minutes.
cta.description: Connect your bank account, copy one script, and your supporters can pay without leaving your page.
